_source: Elecrow-RD/CrowPanel-Advanced-7inch-ESP32-P4-HMI-AI-Display-1024x600-IPS-Touch-Screen, board V1.2: schematic nets SD1_SCK/CMD/D0 -> GPIO43/44/39, example Lesson08 bsp_sd.c (SDMMC slot 0, 1-bit, 10 MHz). DAT1-3 not wired; no card detect. Pad domain VDDPST_5 is fed by ESP32_LDO4, MicroPython's P4 default SD LDO channel. ldo null: MicroPython must not take LDO4, since releasing it switches it off, and with it GPIO39-48: the touch panel's I2C (45/46) and the panel goes dark. The pads are powered from boot without it.
